item.title: [release-26.05] zoneminder: 1.36.38 -> 1.36.39+git20260703_cfac136 + fix CVE-2026-102296
item.description:
ZoneMinder has quietly released version 1.36.39 under 1.36.x series to fix a number of security fixes. However, because NixOS unstable/26.11 has already moved to 1.38.x series and 1.36.x is now under "best-effort security fixes" ^1, this will likely be the last update for 1.36.x in NixOS 26.05 before it goes EoL in Dec 2026. So I've decided to go ahead and bring in the tip of release-1.36 branch without waiting for another release.

In addition, upon closer inspection, it's been found that CVE-2026- 102296 does affect 1.36.x line and requires the fix to be backported. I've backported it and included in this PR (and also submitted upstream).

For "changelog", see:

https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zoneminder/compare/1.36.38...cfac1365084ffd7ee4074de17d861c906d4b4708

Not-cherry-picked-because: unstable has advanced to 1.38.x series

item.title: emacs: patch CVE-2026-108976
item.description:
Incomplete fix for Emacs CVE-2026-79992

Wonyoung Jung of 78ResearchLab, using their PatchHawk tool, discovered that the fix for CVE-2026-79992 was incomplete.

The tramp-user-regexp failed to check for some additional problematic characters in user names, meaning that exploitation was still possible.

The attached patch by TRAMP maintainer Michael Albinus addresses the problem. It will be included in Emacs 31.2 though that won't be released soon.

Message and patch taken from: https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/10/11/1

Ref: #573231
